entities.summary: The National Pirogov Medical University is a medical state-sponsored university in Vinnytsia, Ukraine founded in 1921. In 1960 the institute was named after Nikolai Pirogov, in 1984 it was awarded the Order of the Badge of Honour. Since 1994, Vinnytsia Medical Institute has been certified and accredited by IV level of accreditation as a university. In 2002, the university acquired national status. Viktoriia Viktorivna Petrushenko, Doctor of Science, Professor, and famous surgeon is rector of the university.
